tasks.label: Quartus: Compile Project (Auto-Detect)
args: $d = '${fileDirname}'; if (-not $d) { $d = '${workspaceFolder}' }; while ($d -and -not (Get-ChildItem -Path $d -Filter '*.qpf')) { $p = Split-Path $d -Parent; if ($p -eq $d) { break }; $d = $p }; $q = Get-ChildItem -Path $d -Filter '*.qpf' | Select-Object -First 1; if ($q) { Set-Location $d; & 'C:\intelFPGA_lite\20.1\quartus\bin64\quartus_sh.exe' --flow compile $q.BaseName } else { Write-Error 'No Quartus project (.qpf) found!' }

tasks.label: ModelSim: Run Simulation (Auto-Detect)
args: $d = '${fileDirname}'; if (-not $d) { $d = '${workspaceFolder}' }; while ($d -and -not (Get-ChildItem -Path $d -Filter '*.qpf')) { $p = Split-Path $d -Parent; if ($p -eq $d) { break }; $d = $p }; $q = Get-ChildItem -Path $d -Filter '*.qpf' | Select-Object -First 1; if ($q) { Set-Location $d; $doFile = Join-Path $d ('simulation/modelsim/' + $q.BaseName + '_run_msim_rtl_verilog.do'); if (Test-Path $doFile) { & 'C:\intelFPGA_lite\20.1\modelsim_ase\win32aloem\vsim.exe' -do $doFile } else { Write-Error ('ModelSim .do file not found at: ' + $doFile + '. Make sure you have compiled at least once in Quartus with NativeLink Simulation configured!'); exit 1 } } else { Write-Error 'No Quartus project (.qpf) found!' }
